changelog: Initial release of the ACN Economy persistent stock and logistics engine.
Centralized physical stocks for retail businesses and regional warehouses.
Server-authoritative double-entry transaction and movement ledger.
In-game logistics with live delivery missions, box carry animations, and warehouse orders.
Full in-game 3D Raycast admin configurator via /conf_acn_economy.
Seamless native integration with acn_bridge and acn_supermarket v1.25.0.
